description: This Java interface defines a repository for LoanBuyDownFeeBalance entities in a Spring Data JPA context, providing methods to query the database for specific loan buy-down fee balance records based on various criteria.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all LoanBuyDownFeeBalance records for a specific loan where the balance isn't closed, ordered by date and creation date.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all open and non-deleted LoanBuyDownFeeBalance records for a specific loan, ordered by date and creation date.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLoanTransactionIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Finds a specific non-deleted, open LoanBuyDownFeeBalance record based on loan ID and transaction ID.

methods.name: findBalanceForAdjustment
methods.description: Finds a LoanBuyDownFeeBalance record suitable for adjustment based on a transaction ID, joining related transactions.

methods.name: findBaseTransactionInfo
methods.description: Fetches summarized DTO information about a base transaction related to a specific loan transaction.
